item.title: Sea Eye - Like a Fish | Filmsupply Films
item.description:
Like a Fish” is a powerful short film for Sea-Eye, an NGO rescuing refugees in the Mediterranean. What begins as a joyful father teaching his son to swim quickly turns devastating, as the boy is suddenly alone in open water, clinging to his father’s words: “like a fish.” The film is a stark reminder that no child should ever have to swim for their life.
